title: A strictly hyperbolic symmetrizable complex Kac-Moody twin building has a K-equivariant simplicial realization on the timelike semisimple adjoint cone preserving Weyl distance and codistance
author: Lisa Carbone; Alex J. Feingold; Walter Freyn
source_title: A Lightcone Embedding of the Twin Building  of a Hyperbolic Kac-Moody Group
difficulty_reason: The proof builds a geometric chamber model in the Lorentzian Cartan slice and glues its compact-real-form translates by parabolic face stabilizers. It uses explicit simple-root SU(2) Cartan rotations to relate wall geometry to the building panels, then proves well-definedness, injectivity, surjectivity and both Weyl-valued distance compatibilities. The target is the semisimple adjoint-orbit model at fixed negative norm, not all elements of the infinite-dimensional Lie algebra.
source_version: Official SIGMA 16 (2020) article 045, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2020.045; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Read the full Theorem6.1 construction/proof and the strict-hyperbolic supporting geometry: compact-real-form Lorentzian Cartan slice, adjoint orbit/wall formulas, explicit simple-root rotations4.5-4.6, simplicial chamber construction5.1 and K/T-times-chamber quotient(4.4). The proof explicitly checks face equivalence, K-equivariance, stabilizer injectivity, strict-branch surjectivity and Weyl distance/codistance. Standard twin BN-pair/Coxeter and compact Cartan conjugacy facts are identified prior background. Physical page22 was rendered and viewed: the journal PDF is visibly clean despite obsolete duplicated text-layer fragments. Only the strictly hyperbolic branch is selected; null-boundary compactification and rank-two infinity-building variants are excluded.

statement_scope: Theorem6.1 restricted to strictly hyperbolic symmetrizable generalized Cartan matrix A, its specified complex adjoint Kac-Moody group G, compact real form K with Lie algebra k, and r<0. Let H be the union of Ad_K translates of the standard compact Cartan t and H_r^plus/minus its two timelike fixed-norm components with the simplicial model of Section5. The constructed Psi_r is K-equivariant, bijective on each building half onto that model, and preserves Weyl-valued chamber distance and codistance. No G-equivariance, ambient Riemannian isometry, all-of-k surjectivity or nonspecified boundary-ray assertion is added.
